fields.Name: T126 - AI Agent Requests Approve Reject Dialog
fields.Description: Exercises the human-in-the-loop request flow: agent-requests-resource card click → mj-agent-request-dialog → agent-request-panel with OnApprove/OnReject/OnRespond - a bespoke approval UX not covered by any list/section-nav test.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the AI application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), then open the Agent Requests section. If any request cards are listed, click a request card to open its detail dialog. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away. Success is that clicking a request card opens a detail dialog/panel showing the full request, and for an actionable (pending/'Requested') request it presents response controls such as Approve / Reject / Respond. Seeing the request detail dialog render with its action controls is success - you do NOT need to actually approve or reject. If there are no requests, a valid 'No agent requests yet' empty state counts.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Agent Requests list renders (cards with type/priority/status), OR a valid empty state ('No agent requests yet')
Clicking a request card opens a detail dialog/panel; for an actionable request, Approve/Reject/Respond controls are visible
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
